title: Co-located ship and AUV multibeam bathymetry corpus: processed grids, masks, co-registration and tile tables (companion data of GRL 2026GL125574)
description: Processed co-located seafloor bathymetry pairs for validating super-resolution of ship multibeam: 52 pairs, each a near-bottom AUV multibeam grid (1-2 m) and the independent hull-mounted ship multibeam grid (10-150 m native cells) of the same footprint, harmonized to a common UTM grid and co-registered, with validity masks, per-sounding ship product rasters, co-registration parameters, the datum statistic, and the frozen tile tables (s_lr, A_fine, held-out GBT_ship and P-V1 predictions) that reproduce every score in the paper. Groups: development (39 pairs, 16 units + EW0207), blind test 1 (5 pairs) and blind test 2 (8 sites), plus a manifest of excluded pairs. Both pre-registrations, the committed blind calls, deviation notes and scoring outputs are included. Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, metres positive up, EPSG UTM codes. Sources: MGDS/IEDA, NOAA NCEI, PANGAEA, USGS; each source data set must be cited. 24 pairs inherit CC BY-NC-SA from their AUV grid.
license: cc-by-4.0 (record); per-pair CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where inherited, see pairs.csv
